dataset: Zenodo15309060, all11 published processed CSVs; no new data download
scope: Exploratory reuse, source-row holdout with unverified complete timestamps; not prospective or event-alarm validation
model_selection: highest validation AP within each feature set; earlier learner wins ties; all candidates saved
threshold: validation Youden J with specificity>=0.8; single-class validation disables classification operating point
calibration: validation-only sigmoid on clipped logits, C=1, no class weights; nonpositive slope falls back to validation prevalence
reference_baseline: constant training-prevalence score on identical test anchors
primary_comparison: raw combined versus raw wearable_time, paired per-subject AP; same reference rows and wearable opportunity mask
secondary: calibrated versus raw Brier and training-prior Brier; AUC, AP, point sensitivity, specificity, reliability and per-subject directions
missingness: absent context columns inserted as NA; model imputation training-only; source zeros retained with uncertainty flag, not proof of no real injections
safety_scope: CGM and hypoglycemia excluded from inputs; IOB is a source unitless injection-activity index, not remaining insulin units; no dose recommendations
acceptance: engineering checks, independent point metric reconstruction and source-row split audit must pass. Positive primary AP contrast requires paired 95% interval lower>0, exploratory/unadjusted. Calibration improvement alone is not detection improvement.
support_audit: Source IOB up to240min plus reference confirmation15; nominal 1min-row assumption, >=301row separation; source timestamps still unverified.
